name: ImportMessage - Unreadable Snapshot
description: The message that used to not exist. A failed import logged to a console the user cannot see and then closed the page, so it looked exactly like a success that did nothing. Now the parser's own position is reported — and it is the position in what the user pasted, not an offset into a repaired copy that does not exist in front of them. Rendered as an alert, because this is the one the user has to act on.
